# Java Edition protocol/Development version

> Minecraft Java snapshot: `1.20.6`  
> Protocol version: `766`

This page documents the changes from the [last stable Minecraft release](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol "Protocol") (currently [1.20.6, protocol 766](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol_version_numbers?action=edit&redlink=1 "Protocol version numbers (page does not exist)")) to the current pre-release (currently [1.21-pre2, protocol Snapshot 200](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol_version_numbers?action=edit&redlink=1 "Protocol version numbers (page does not exist)")). Note that this page contains bleeding-edge information that may not be completely or correctly documented.

One who wishes to commandeer the merging of this into [Protocol](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol "Protocol") when an update is made must be sure to respect any changes that may have occurred to the respective packets there.

## Configuration

### Clientbound

#### Clientbound Report Details (configuration)

Contains a list of key-value text entries that are included in any crash or disconnection report generated during connection to the server.

| Packet ID | State | Bound To | Field Name | | Field Type | | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0x0F | Configuration | Client | Details Count | | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") (32) | | The number of details in the following array. |
| Details | Title | [Array](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Array "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | [String](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:String "Java Edition protocol/Data types") (128) |  |
| Description | [String](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:String "Java Edition protocol/Data types") (4096) |  |

#### Clientbound Server Links (configuration)

This packet contains a list of links that the Notchian client will display in the menu available from the pause menu. Link labels can be built-in or custom (i.e., any text).

| Packet ID | State | Bound To | Field Name | | Field Type | | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0x10 | Configuration | Client | Links Count | | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | | The number of links in the following array. |
| Links | Is built-in | [Array](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Array "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | [Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Determines if the following label is built-in (from enum) or custom (text component). |
| Label | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Enum](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Enum "Java Edition protocol/Data types") / [Text Component](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Text_Component "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | See below. |
| URL | [String](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:String "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Valid URL. |

| ID | Name | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Bug Report | Displayed on connection error screen; included as a comment in the disconnection report. |
| 1 | Community Guidelines |  |
| 2 | Support |  |
| 3 | Status |  |
| 4 | Feedback |  |
| 5 | Community |  |
| 6 | Website |  |
| 7 | Forums |  |
| 8 | News |  |
| 9 | Announcements |  |
